title: Heron Cottage Vacation Rental
meta_description: Heron Cottage is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.

Outdoor SpaceGas Grill & Two Porches (one screened)Parking for 3 VehiclesFour 26" Adult Bikes Included Seasonally (Dec–Feb bikes not included; additional rentals available)Not pet-friendly (homeowner’s dogs travel with them)Brand New to the Rental Market – Designer Lakefront HomeWelcome to Heron Cottage, a stunning lakefront retreat in the exclusive Watersound West Beach community. Nestled near the private beach boardwalk and community pool, this 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath home offers serene lake views and direct access to the protected natural beauty of Deer Lake State Park. Enjoy fishing, turtle watching, and peaceful walks along the scenic trails.The open-concept main living area features coastal décor, comfortable furnishings, and a screened-in veranda with a built-in gas grill, outdoor seating, and an 8-person dining table—perfect for relaxing after a day at the beach or exploring 30A. The main-level master suite offers a king bed, luxurious en-suite bath with double vanities, soaking tub, and separate shower, plus veranda access. Upstairs, three bedrooms each have private baths, covered porch access, and a cozy loft area.Watersound West Beach Amenities:Heated Zero-Entry Pool with Lounge Areas & GrillsPrivate Deeded Beach AccessGolf Putting GreenScenic Walking TrailsGated, Eco-Friendly CommunityParks, Green Spaces, & Nature TrailsParking & Golf Carts:Designated parking for up to 3 vehicles (two in driveway, one in front of garage; garage use not permitted)On-street public parking available (first-come, first-served; parking pass required)Golf carts: Outside rentals not allowedReservation & Policies:NO SMOKINGPublished rates exclude taxes & fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior (or full if booking within 60 days)5% cancellation fee applies; initial payment fully refundable if canceled >60 days before arrivalOptional travel insurance available (must be purchased before final payment)Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be 25+ years oldExperience the luxury and tranquility of Watersound West Beach at Heron Cottage, where every detail is designed to make your 30A getaway unforgettable.
